label: Q4c actions into the 3 wallets, 30d
sql: SELECT receipt_receiver_account_id, receipt_predecessor_account_id, action_kind, COUNT(*) AS n_receipts, MIN(block_date) AS first_date, MAX(block_date) AS last_date FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions` WHERE block_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND receipt_receiver_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY n_receipts DESC LIMIT 40
